prompt: Complete B2.5 Merge Gate Baseline Closure. Repair cross-platform runtime listener diagnosis and bound Skills Catalog remote reference resolution without weakening exposure or integrity checks. Add focused tests, run repository merge gates, fix only current-delta or confirmed baseline defects, and attach truthful evidence. Do not commit or create a pull request.
allowed_actions: Inspect and edit runtime exposure listener diagnostics and their tests
Inspect and edit Skills Catalog reference fetching, cache validation, manifest build behavior, and their tests
Add narrowly scoped timeout, portability, and deterministic fallback helpers
Run focused tests, full tests, typecheck, builds, migration checks, UI gates, and diff checks
Create B2.5 delivery receipt, evidence, timeline, and advisory review records
forbidden_actions: Change Verrail product or domain behavior
Disable exposure checks, test files, or repository gates
Accept unpinned or integrity-unchecked remote catalog content
Rewrite unrelated inherited runtime, plugin, workspace, or skills behavior
Commit, push, create a pull request, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run server/src/__tests__/conversation-service.test.ts server/src/__tests__/conversation-routes.test.ts server/src/__tests__/company-cloud-floor.test.ts server/src/__tests__/openapi-routes.test.ts ui/src/components/Layout.test.tsx ui/src/App.test.tsx ui/src/components/VerrailManagementSidebar.test.tsx ui/src/lib/company-routes.test.ts ui/src/lib/verrail-section-navigation.test.ts
expected_evidence: Cross-platform listener diagnosis focused test result
Skills Catalog timeout, fallback, and integrity focused test result
Repository-wide typecheck, tests, and build result
Migration, UI token, bundle, and diff gate results
Advisory commit and pull-request readiness decision
stop_conditions: A proposed fix would weaken wildcard-listener exposure detection
A catalog fallback cannot prove pinned source identity and content integrity
A remaining failure cannot be isolated from active local services or reproduced against the base commit
Closure requires changing unrelated product behavior or discarding existing work
